11月5日（周四），华尔街市值蒸发3.2万亿美元。
纳斯达克综合指数下跌5.52%，创下自2025年4月以来最差单日表现，因投资者抛售AI芯片股。

inlines.text:
11月5日（周四），华尔街市值蒸发3.2万亿美元。
纳斯达克综合指数下跌5.52%，创下自2025年4月以来最差单日表现，因投资者抛售AI芯片股。

blocks.text: 市场崩盘源于投资者的恐慌，他们担心民主党控制的国会将从根本上放缓高杠杆的AI支出热潮。

inlines.text: 市场崩盘源于投资者的恐慌，他们担心民主党控制的国会将从根本上放缓高杠杆的AI支出热潮。

blocks.text: 高盛表示，短期暂停令可能影响约45%的美国计划数据中心容量。

inlines.text: 高盛表示，短期暂停令可能影响约45%的美国计划数据中心容量。

blocks.text: 数据中心的中期损失对CoreWeave及其他靠债务融资的GPU租赁商打击最大。

inlines.text: 数据中心的中期损失对CoreWeave及其他靠债务融资的GPU租赁商打击最大。

blocks.text: 新建数据中心减少意味着为其配备的GPU和内存订单减少，因此芯片制造商受创最重。

inlines.text: 新建数据中心减少意味着为其配备的GPU和内存订单减少，因此芯片制造商受创最重。

blocks.text: 英伟达下跌9.3%，抹去其2026年涨幅，费城半导体指数下跌12.3%，创下约6.5年来最差单日表现。

blocks.text: SanDisk下跌22%，美光、西部数据和AMD各下跌17%。

inlines.text: SanDisk下跌22%，美光、西部数据和AMD各下跌17%。

blocks.text: 就连Meta总裁Dina Powell McCormick也表示，选举后建设数据中心“将更加困难”。

blocks.text:
Wall Street erased $3.2 tn in market value on Thursday, Nov-5. 
The Nasdaq Composite fell 5.52%, its worst day since April 2025, as investors dumped AI chip stocks.

inlines.text:
Wall Street erased $3.2 tn in market value on Thursday, Nov-5. 
The Nasdaq Composite fell 5.52%, its worst day since April 2025, as investors dumped AI chip stocks.

blocks.text: The market collapse stemmed from investor panic that a Democrat-controlled Congress will fundamentally slow down the highly leveraged AI spending boom.

inlines.text: The market collapse stemmed from investor panic that a Democrat-controlled Congress will fundamentally slow down the highly leveraged AI spending boom.

blocks.text: Goldman Sachs says short-term moratoria could affect about 45% of planned US data centre capacity.

inlines.text: Goldman Sachs says short-term moratoria could affect about 45% of planned US data centre capacity.

blocks.text: Midterm losses for data centres hit CoreWeave and other debt-funded GPU renters hardest.

inlines.text: Midterm losses for data centres hit CoreWeave and other debt-funded GPU renters hardest.

blocks.text: Fewer new data centers means fewer orders for the GPUs and memory that fill them, so chipmakers took the worst hit.

inlines.text: Fewer new data centers means fewer orders for the GPUs and memory that fill them, so chipmakers took the worst hit.

blocks.text: Nvidia sank 9.3%, erasing its 2026 gains, and the Philadelphia Semiconductor index fell 12.3%, its worst day in about 6.5 years.

inlines.text: Nvidia sank 9.3%, erasing its 2026 gains, and the Philadelphia Semiconductor index fell 12.3%, its worst day in about 6.5 years.

blocks.text: SanDisk fell 22%, and Micron, Western Digital and AMD each lost 17%.

inlines.text: SanDisk fell 22%, and Micron, Western Digital and AMD each lost 17%.

blocks.text: Even Meta President Dina Powell McCormick said building data centers is “going to be harder” after the elections.
